rows.en: Damn it!
rows.notes: Heard 'shikusho'; most likely 'chikusho' (damn).

rows.en: I can't believe I got shot down!
Don't you flinch!
Don't run! Get in there!
Useless.
rows.notes: Heard 'tsukanee'; likely 'tsukaenee' (useless), matching the next rows.

rows.en: Spineless fools!
rows.notes: Heard 'funuke ya funu'; likely 'fuenuke domo' (spineless cowards).

rows.en: You useless bastards!
Get a grip, you fools!
rows.notes: Transcript is nonsense; guessed a scold from the neighbouring 'ally in trouble' lines.

rows.en: I don't need any reinforcements!
Who asked you to butt in?!
rows.notes: Reinforcements arrive; he resents them.

rows.en: What? Reinforcements?
Such fragile things.
Damn it all!
rows.notes: Heard 'chikushoumei'; likely 'chikushoume'.

rows.en: Couldn't even last that long?!
What? That's it?
Mission accomplished, is it?
Not enough! On to the next one!
Damn it! Just when we're close, we pull out!
rows.notes: 'ei' is likely 'eei' (damn it).

rows.en: What? Time's up?
It ends like this?!
I don't give a damn about the plan!
That's enough. Pull back, you lot!
Damn it!
rows.notes: Heard 'kusogan'; likely 'kuso' / 'kusoga'.

rows.en: Cover me!
Keep your distance and fire!
Fire!
You're the decoy!
Charge, you monsters!
rows.notes: Unsure who 'bakemono' addresses; taken as a rough term for the squad or partner.

rows.en: Keep going, straight in!
Don't you dare enjoy this more than me!
Get back! You want me to shoot you?!
Just keep charging in!
Here, take this!
rows.notes: Transcript is nonsense; guessed a 'soora, kutabare' type attack shout.

rows.en: Make it count!
rows.notes: Heard '3 bun ni yabareru'; no clear reading; guessed an order to hit hard (between 172 and 174).

rows.en: Go on, land a big one!
Now you've made me serious!
Let's do this!
rows.notes: Heard 'yattia rizui'; guessed 'yatte yaru ze'.

rows.en: Hm?
rows.notes: Number 178 is an acknowledgement for other pilots; kept as written.

rows.en: All right, all right, got it.
Don't give me orders!
Guess I'll back you up, Captain. Real nice and thorough.
rows.notes: Garbled; read as a sarcastic offer to cover the captain.

rows.en: Captain's in a pinch, huh?
rows.notes: 'taichou' heard as the homophone for 'physical condition' (taichou ga pinchi).

rows.en: What's wrong, Captain?
Shot down before I could do it myself!
rows.notes: Captain/ally lost; gender of that person unknown so passive.

rows.en: Now I can do whatever I like!
That's what you get for getting cocky!
This is... Men, we're pulling out!
rows.notes: Culture-song event; the Zentradi withdraw.

rows.en: So this is what they call Culture! It sends a thrill through me!
Not bad.
rows.notes: Leading '7' is noise.

rows.en: Some skill you've got. Just as I'd expect.
Stay out of my way.
Make sure I don't shoot you down.
Slow me down and you'll pay for it!
This ain't a joint training drill!
rows.notes: 'doujiku' read as 'goudou' (joint) training.

rows.en: Let's put on a big, flashy firefight!
Quit dawdling! Let's go!
All right, let's get out there too!
Yahoo! Sortie!
All right, let's go wild to our hearts' content!
Don't forget our crew's pride rides on you too!
rows.notes: 'Kamujin ikka' = Quamzin's family/band; rendered 'crew' (glossary has no term).
Garbled; possibly a Zentradi-language line. No safe reading.

rows.en: Let's see what you can do.
rows.notes: 'demae' (delivery) read as 'udemae' (skill).

rows.en: Get in my way again and I'll shoot you down myself!
You made a fool of me!
rows.notes: Heard 'hajikakase yatteyaru'; read as 'haji kakase yagatte'.

rows.en: Anyway, you're one lucky bastard.
rows.notes: Heard 'tonikaku ukeyarou daze'; guessed an 'akuun' (luck) line like the neighbours.

rows.en: Don't get excited over results like this!
Pulling this off is the least I'd expect.
Oh, you made it back in one piece.
That was quite a fun operation.
That fight was a blast!
rows.notes: Heard 'satsuei' (filming); read as 'sentou' (fight).

rows.en: Not bad! I'll let you be my right-hand man!
Nothing's impossible for us, the Quamzin crew!
rows.notes: 'kanou' (possible) read as 'fukanou' (impossible).

rows.en: All right, I'm counting on you next time too.
Run away and you'll pay for it!
rows.notes: 'tada ja sasareru' read as 'tada ja okanee'.

rows.en: You can at least be useful as a decoy.
rows.notes: 'hai' read as 'seizei'.

rows.en: Watch your back, or you'll get shot from behind!
rows.notes: Unclear whether he threatens or warns; kept as a warning that works either way.

rows.en: Quit spacing out! Follow me!
Watch how the Quamzin crew fights.
Don't make me waste time on you!
Hey! I'm leaving my support to you!
